positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationVerification
positions.frame: Is the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration verified against a reference standard and holding across the observing band?
positions.why: The prose statement (src-1) and the two structured field entries (src-2, src-3) all converge on one settled claim — the instrument is calibrated at 88.4 MHz and that calibration was verified against the June reference plates, holding across the full band. The register and conviction reads mark all three as flat, unhedged, matter-of-fact assertions of the same fact in different formats (narrative vs. labelled field), so they cohere as one directional read of verified instrument state rather than three separate claims.
